explorations.title: See an angle as rotation
explorations.purpose: Show that an angle measures how far the terminal ray rotates from the initial ray.

explorations.title: Read coordinates from a circle
explorations.purpose: Connect a rotating angle to its live coordinates and the signs of sine and cosine.

explorations.title: Unroll the circle into a wave
explorations.purpose: Show how the y-coordinate of a point moving around the unit circle becomes the sine graph.

explorations.title: Scale a triangle, keep the ratio
explorations.purpose: Demonstrate that changing the size of a right triangle does not change the trigonometric ratio for a fixed angle.

explorations.title: Measure a tower without climbing
explorations.purpose: Show how a ground distance and an angle of elevation reveal an inaccessible height.

explorations.title: Build one radian
explorations.purpose: Show one radian as the central angle whose arc length equals the circle radius.

explorations.title: Watch a clock measure rotation
explorations.purpose: Connect elapsed time to the continuously changing angle of a rotating clock hand.

explorations.title: See tangent as a ratio
explorations.purpose: Make tangent visible by changing the angle while tracking opposite divided by adjacent.

explorations.title: Find solutions where graphs meet
explorations.purpose: Show that every intersection of y = sin(x) and a horizontal target line is a solution.

explorations.title: Locate a point by triangulation
explorations.purpose: Show how two measured sightlines create a triangle that locates an otherwise unreachable point.

explorations.title: Decompose a navigation vector
explorations.purpose: Show how a direction and distance split into horizontal and vertical movement to locate an endpoint.

explorations.title: See a repeating signal
explorations.purpose: Show how a repeating quantity rises and falls through time as a sine-like wave.
